name: ES Prior-Close Volume-Scar Handoff v1
instrument: ES transaction-level prior-session anchor and one-minute current-session signal with one MES execution unit
source: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ES trades and one-minute OHLCV
hypothesis: The prior session's most heavily negotiated closing price is an inventory scar that can persist across the overnight participant handoff. When the current cash opening moves both accepted value and its terminal close to the same side of that scar, overnight inventory has been digested and the new cash valuation should persist.

signal.prior_anchor_window: immediately prior full RTH session, 15:00 through 15:29:59.999999 ET
signal.prior_volume_scar: ES transaction price with greatest summed trade size in the prior anchor window
signal.scar_tie_break: among tied prices choose the one closest to the prior-window transaction VWAP; if still tied choose the lower price
signal.opening_center: volume-weighted mean of current-opening one-minute typical price (high + low + close) / 3
signal.long_signal: opening center and 09:59 close are both strictly above the prior volume scar
signal.short_signal: opening center and 09:59 close are both strictly below the prior volume scar
signal.zero_rule: no trade when the two confirmations disagree or touch the scar
signal.roll_rule: no trade unless the prior scar's ES instrument ID equals the current opening bar instrument ID

execution.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.long_stop_trigger: one ES tick below the current opening center
execution.short_stop_trigger: one ES tick above the current opening center
execution.stop_fill: the trigger price unless the stop bar opens beyond it, then the worse bar open plus one adverse tick
execution.entry_validity: skip if the stop is not adverse to entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

decision: Retain for forward paper tracking only. It passed frequency, yearly, side, cost, and aggregate holdout gates but failed the five-best-trade and below-20-percent bootstrap-loss requirements.

deep_diagnostic.scar_specificity: The prior scar beat prior transaction VWAP, prior terminal price, and a two-session-stale scar in development and secondary holdout, but the same-window VWAP and terminal controls were also profitable.
deep_diagnostic.verdict: Mechanism is plausible but not unique, entry timing is fragile, payoff remains tail-dependent, and diversification is weak. Preserve only as an unchanged forward paper candidate.

holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was evaluated only after every initial development gate passed. It is secondary because those years have informed the wider research program.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: using the current day's scar, overnight center, prior close, or another prior anchor
changing either auction window or the scar tie-break
adding distance, gap, volume, side, weekday, volatility, or regime filters
changing the stop reference or exit time
selecting years or directions after results
